nativeMessaging.title: Communicates with desktop software
nativeMessaging.explanation: Can exchange data with an approved application installed outside Firefox.

proxy.title: Controls proxy settings
proxy.explanation: Can route browser traffic through a different network destination.

debugger.title: Uses browser debugging tools
debugger.explanation: Can inspect and control browser activity through privileged debugging capabilities.

pkcs11.title: Installs security device modules
pkcs11.explanation: Can register cryptographic modules that supply certificates Firefox will trust.

activityLog.title: Monitors other extensions
activityLog.explanation: Can watch the API calls and events of other installed extensions.

management.title: Inspects installed add-ons
management.explanation: Can read details about other add-ons and use the management actions Firefox supports.

cookies.title: Accesses browser cookies
cookies.explanation: Can read or change cookies for sites covered by its host access.

webRequestBlocking.title: Changes network requests
webRequestBlocking.explanation: Can block or modify browser requests for sites covered by its host access.

webRequestFilterResponse.title: Reads and rewrites response bodies
webRequestFilterResponse.explanation: Can inspect and alter the content returned by sites covered by its host access.

webRequestFilterResponse.serviceWorkerSc.title: Rewrites service worker code
webRequestFilterResponse.serviceWorkerSc.explanation: Can alter the service worker scripts a site installs, which then run on later visits.

contentSettings.title: Changes per-site content permissions
contentSettings.explanation: Can change what sites are allowed to do, such as running scripts or using the camera.

publicSuffix.title: Queries public suffix data
publicSuffix.explanation: Can ask Firefox where the registrable part of a domain name begins.

tabGroups.title: Manages tab groups
tabGroups.explanation: Can read, create, and change the groups your tabs are organized into.

background.title: Keeps running in the background
background.explanation: Asks Firefox to start it at launch and keep it running while the browser is open.

webRequestAuthProvider.title: Answers authentication prompts
webRequestAuthProvider.explanation: Can supply credentials for HTTP authentication challenges on sites it can access.

declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess.title: Changes requests on approved sites
declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess.explanation: Can apply request-blocking or redirect rules to sites it can access.

clipboardRead.title: Reads the clipboard
clipboardRead.explanation: Can read text or other supported data copied to the system clipboard.

history.title: Reads browsing history
history.explanation: Can inspect and modify the browser's history.

bookmarks.title: Reads and changes bookmarks
bookmarks.explanation: Can read the full bookmark tree and create, move, or delete entries.

identity.title: Obtains account sign-in tokens
identity.explanation: Can run web authentication flows and receive the resulting access tokens.

scripting.title: Injects scripts into pages
scripting.explanation: Can run its own scripts and styles on sites covered by its host access.

userScripts.title: Runs user-provided scripts
userScripts.explanation: Can register and execute third-party scripts on sites covered by its host access.

geolocation.title: Reads your location
geolocation.explanation: Can request the device location that Firefox reports.

pageCapture.title: Saves complete pages
pageCapture.explanation: Can capture the full content of pages it can access, including signed-in views.

browserSettings.title: Changes browser settings
browserSettings.explanation: Can read and modify Firefox settings that affect browsing behavior.

downloads.open.title: Opens downloaded files
downloads.open.explanation: Can ask the operating system to open files that Firefox downloaded.

tabHide.title: Hides browser tabs
tabHide.explanation: Can hide tabs from view, which can conceal activity from you.

mozillaAddons.title: Accesses Mozilla add-on sites
mozillaAddons.explanation: Holds privileged access to Mozilla's own add-on domains.

downloads.title: Accesses downloads
downloads.explanation: Can observe and manage files downloaded through Firefox.

clipboardWrite.title: Writes to the clipboard
clipboardWrite.explanation: Can replace text or supported data on the system clipboard.

privacy.title: Changes privacy settings
privacy.explanation: Can view or modify Firefox privacy-related settings.

browsingData.title: Clears browsing data
browsingData.explanation: Can remove browser data such as cache, history, or cookies.

webRequest.title: Observes network requests
webRequest.explanation: Can observe browser requests for sites covered by its host access.

webNavigation.title: Follows page navigation
webNavigation.explanation: Can see navigation events across the sites covered by its host access.

declarativeNetRequest.title: Blocks or redirects requests
declarativeNetRequest.explanation: Can apply packaged rules that block or redirect browser requests.

declarativeNetRequestFeedback.title: Reports matched request rules
declarativeNetRequestFeedback.explanation: Can see which of its request rules matched, which reveals browsing activity.

dns.title: Performs DNS lookups
dns.explanation: Can resolve domain names through Firefox.

tabs.title: Reads tab details
tabs.explanation: Can read sensitive tab properties such as page titles and addresses.

sessions.title: Reads recently closed tabs
sessions.explanation: Can list and restore tabs and windows you recently closed.

topSites.title: Reads most-visited sites
topSites.explanation: Can read the list of sites Firefox considers your most visited.

contextualIdentities.title: Manages container tabs
contextualIdentities.explanation: Can create, change, and remove the container identities that separate browsing.

find.title: Searches page text
find.explanation: Can run find-in-page and read the surrounding text of the matches.

search.title: Uses installed search engines
search.explanation: Can read the installed search engines and run searches with them.

devtools.title: Extends developer tools
devtools.explanation: Can add developer tools panels that inspect the page being debugged.

geckoProfiler.title: Records browser performance profiles
geckoProfiler.explanation: Can capture detailed profiles of what Firefox is executing.

networkStatus.title: Reads network connection status
networkStatus.explanation: Can observe the type and state of the current network connection.

urlbar.title: Adds address bar results
urlbar.explanation: Can contribute suggestions to the address bar and see what is typed there.

telemetry.title: Submits Firefox telemetry
telemetry.explanation: Can record data through Firefox's internal telemetry system.

normandyAddonStudy.title: Participates in Mozilla studies
normandyAddonStudy.explanation: Can take part in Mozilla's managed add-on study system.

activeTab.title: Accesses the selected tab after a click
activeTab.explanation: Receives temporary access only after you deliberately activate the extension.

storage.title: Stores local settings
storage.explanation: Can save its own preferences and state inside Firefox.

unlimitedStorage.title: Stores data without a size limit
unlimitedStorage.explanation: Can keep its own data without the usual local storage quota.

alarms.title: Schedules background timers
alarms.explanation: Can schedule its own code to run at a later time.

menus.title: Adds context menu items
menus.explanation: Can add its own entries to Firefox context menus.

contextMenus.title: Adds context menu items
contextMenus.explanation: Can add its own entries to Firefox context menus.

menus.overrideContext.title: Replaces context menu contents
menus.overrideContext.explanation: Can substitute its own menu for the standard context menu it provides.

theme.title: Changes browser appearance
theme.explanation: Can apply themes that change Firefox colors and images.

idle.title: Detects when you step away
idle.explanation: Can tell whether the computer is active, idle, or locked.

captivePortal.title: Detects sign-in networks
captivePortal.explanation: Can tell whether the current network requires a captive portal sign-in.
